item_id: wf_001_short_read_qc_trim
query: 'Perform paired-end quality control and trimming on the provided Illumina reads.

  Detect and remove adapters solely through mate-overlap analysis, without supplying
  an adapter sequence or running a separate adapter-sequence autodetection step. Treat
  bases below Phred 20 as low quality. Discard the pair if either mate contains more
  than 40 percent low-quality bases, more than 5 ambiguous `N` bases, or is shorter
  than 15 bases after adapter trimming. Do not perform any other trimming or base
  correction.

  Write the synchronized retained mates to `final_answer/trimmed_forward.fastqsanger.gz`
  and `final_answer/trimmed_reverse.fastqsanger.gz`.

  '
